title: The edge map path loses its two force unwraps and its unchecked Sendable
goal: Two spots in the measurement code crash rather than fail gracefully if their assumptions ever break, and one core type opts out of the compiler's thread-safety checks. Remove all three so the measure tools keep the repo's safety rules.
notes: Sources/PhotonzCore/EdgeMap.swift:79 (luma!.count), Sources/PhotonzRender/EdgeMapAnalyzer.swift:103 (CGColorSpace(name:)!), Sources/PhotonzCore/SelectionRegion.swift:12 (@unchecked Sendable). CLAUDE.md: no force unwraps in core or render; core must be value-typed and Sendable. Shared code, both releases.
acceptance: No force unwrap remains in Sources/PhotonzCore or Sources/PhotonzRender (the grep in the task log shows zero hits), behavior unchanged, tests green.
SelectionRegion in PhotonzCore is Sendable without @unchecked, or carries a comment explaining exactly why it cannot be.
ElementDetectionFixtureTests and AlignmentFixtureTests still pin the same numbers.
